intent: SCALE: deep nesting in sequenceDiagram - 10 levels of interleaved loop/alt/par blocks, each containing two messages. Tests nested block-frame layout and whether 10 concentric frame labels remain readable; in dark theme loopTextColor #eceff4 over stacked semi-transparent frame fills is the contrast risk.
